analyst_view.overall: Benfica, five points off the top and the league's top scorers (27), have won seven straight and beat Lech Poznań 3-1 in the Europa League on Thursday. Estrela (12th) have lost four league games in a row and have not kept a clean sheet in 12 matches. Marco Silva said Benfica play three games in seven days and he is rotating within positions; he also named Lenglet in the squad, though the site lists him as missing.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals, with Benfica expected to score most of them. Benfica score freely and Estrela haven't kept a clean sheet in 12, but Silva plans some rotation after Thursday and admitted clean sheets have been a weakness, which keeps Estrela in it. We stay with the site.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.0 corners, mostly Benfica's. Silva expects Estrela to drop into a back five in a mid-low block, which usually means Benfica corners, and that's what the site already shows.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.0 cards. Silva called Estrela combative and their ground hard to play at, but we found nothing on referee António Nobre's style this season, so we keep the site's number.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.2 shots. Rotation could take a little off Benfica's intensity, but Vangelis Pavlidis (10 league goals) is expected to start after resting on Thursday. These roughly balance.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. Benfica have scored 20 goals in their last seven games and Estrela concede in every match, so we lean slightly higher on Benfica's accuracy against a struggling defence.
